summary: Quiet residential kerb beside a vacant treed lot, houses 18-23 m away.
reasons: Nearest houses 18-23 m on own side
Treed vacant lot beside the kerb
Very flat, cars already park here

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings on the south side are 18 m (37 m) and 22 m (53 m), then 23 m (73 m); a treed gap between the houses helps. Houses across the road on the north side add to the exposure, so homes are within about 25 m all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a grass verge and vehicles parked on this side in the imagery; there is room to pull in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet local street, little through traffic, ending in a turning bend by bush.
drivers.convention: Cars park along it, but no campervans or overnight use seen.

flags: Flat: about 0.5% grade over the section (mean 2.4%, max 11.6% only near the start)
Mapped car park 97 m away; not used for this section
Waterway 158 m away; elevation about 35 m
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the south verge gives shade from the south and west; open to the morning sun from the east.

best_section.where: South side mid-street, opposite the pair of houses, beside the treed block
